items.title: 6.5.1 Tracking the Origin of Products (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Blockchain technology supply chain ke mukhtalif marahil (stages) mein products ke origin (kahan se aaye) aur safar ka suragh lagane ka shaffaf aur mehfooz tareeqa deti hai. Har transaction decentralized ledger par record hone se blockchain yaqeeni banata hai ke kachcha maal dene wale (raw material supplier) se aakhri customer tak har qadam ka suragh mil sake (traceable) aur woh badla na ja sake (immutable). Is suragh se products ke asli hone ki tasdeeq, quality ka yaqeen, aur kisi masle ki jarr (source) dhoondne mein madad milti hai.

blocks.alt: Ek daire ke gird nishanon wali chhe hari tiles, teer ghari ki sui ki simt mein: Supplier, Manufacturer, Fabricator, Intermediary, Retailer aur Customer (End User-Consumer), aur phir wapas Supplier.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.3: Blockchain se chocolate ke maakhaz ka suragh (kitab ki Figure 6.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Figure 6.3 mein supply chain ke mukhtalif hisson ke darmiyan rishte dikhaye gaye hain. Blockchain suppliers, manufacturers (banane wale), fabricators (pur ze jorne wale), intermediaries (darmiyani), retailers (dukandar) aur customers ke darmiyan har len den record karta hai. Har transaction blockchain par mehfooz likhi jati hai, is liye product ka origin se aakhri sarif (end consumer) tak ka safar dekha ja sakta hai. Maslan jab supplier manufacturer ko kachcha maal deta hai to ek record ban kar blockchain mein jur jata hai. Yahi silsila har marhale par chalta hai: fabricator, intermediary aur retailer sab product ki shaffaf aur qabil-e-tasdeeq tareekh mein apna hissa likhte hain. Aakhir mein customer yeh data dekh kar product ka origin aur us ka mutawaqqa maeyar (expected standards) par poora utarna confirm kar sakta hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kuch fankar (artists) apna digital art bechne ke liye blockchain istemal karte hain. Har fan paare ka ek munfarid digital signature hota hai jo saabit karta hai ke yahi asli (original) hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain ko IoT ke saath jorna supply chain management ko kaise behtar banata hai (exercise short question 6)?
blocks.explanation: IoT sensors har marhale par maal ki jagah, temperature aur waqt jaisa data khud record karte hain, aur yeh readings blockchain par likhne se woh chhed chhaar se mehfooz aur chain ke sab logon ke liye wazeh ho jati hain. Is se khareedar ko bharosa hota hai ke maal kahan se aur kaise aaya, masle ki jarr jaldi milti hai, aur dhoka aur ghaltiyan kam hoti hain. (Kitab 6.6.2.2 mein batati hai ke IoT aur blockchain ka mel IoT data ka tamper-proof record deta hai; sensors ki tafseel aam ilm hai.)

items: Har len den decentralized ledger par: supplier se customer tak har qadam traceable aur immutable.
Customer product ka origin aur maeyar confirm kar sakta hai (chocolate ki misal, Figure 6.3).
